Creator guide

Writing a better headline

A headline is a promise. Make it specific enough to trust.

Start with the reader’s decision

Before choosing a format, write down what the reader should understand, decide, or do. This keeps the work useful when the draft gets longer.

Make the shape visible

Use a brief to name the audience, core question, sections, examples, and next action. The Content Brief Builder can help you make that structure concrete.

Check the promise

  • Does the opening match the title?
  • Can someone scan the structure?
  • Is there a specific next step?
